content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Charlotte

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your PMP Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and verifiable project-management experience. Review PMI's specific hour requirements for your background—a secondary degree paired with relevant work hours, or a higher degree with fewer hours. Gather documentation of your project experience to support your application.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP Bootcamp, delivered by active certified practitioners. Attend instructor-led sessions covering project-management frameworks, processes, and exam domains—all online, on a schedule that fits working professionals in finance, banking, healthcare, energy, and manufacturing sectors across Charlotte.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Register with PMI and submit your formal application, including proof of your education, project experience, and completion of the 35 contact-hour course. Pay the PMI examination fee and allow time for application review before your exam eligibility is confirmed.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the PMP Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—including practice tests, study guides, and Q&A support—to reinforce your learning. Schedule your proctored exam through PMI's testing partner and take the assessment online from your location in Charlotte or anywhere convenient.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After passing, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) over a three-year renewal cycle to keep your credential active. Pursue ongoing education, volunteer in project-management roles, or contribute to the profession—options that align with career growth in Charlotte's dynamic industries.
